name: Explainer Video bot
tagline: Turns a topic into an upload-ready explainer with checked figures and AI narration.
description: Give it a subject and it assembles the whole video: a story structure to carry the argument, animated motion graphics, real footage where it helps and an AI voice-over on top. Figures are verified before they reach the screen, so the piece is data-driven rather than vibes. What comes back is ready to upload.
author: cu30rry_
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
